tasks.title: Future skills essay
tasks.instruction: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing what future skills young people will need. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important future skill for young people to develop?

Notes

Write about:

1. digital literacy
2. teamwork and collaboration
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Future skills review
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in a specialist magazine for educators.

Reviews wanted!

Have you used an online course that teaches future skills such as critical thinking, problem-solving or digital literacy? We want to hear about your experience. Write a review of the course for our magazine.

Describe what the course covered and how it was delivered. Say how useful it was for developing the skills it promised. Would you recommend it to other educators? Why?

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Future skills article
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a youth website.

Articles wanted!

Future skills: what should we learn now?

What future skill do you think is most important for young people, and how can they develop it? Write an article for our website.

Describe one future skill you consider essential. Suggest a practical way young people can learn or practise this skill. Explain how this could benefit their future career or personal life.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Future skills email
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Alex.

From: Alex
Subject: Future skills course

Hi,
I'm thinking of taking a short course on future skills – maybe about creative thinking or data analysis. I know you've done some courses like that. Can you recommend one? What did you find most useful about it? Also, do you think it's better to study online or in a classroom? And how much time should I expect to spend each week?

Thanks a lot!
Alex

Write your email.
